title: A Atlas for the Typewriter
author: Ines Crane
blurb: Sable Whitlock, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
